name: mila-en
description: Mila — a social game of commitments. Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Static Assets.

scripts.deploy:prod: npm run embed && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply mila-en-db-prod --remote --env production
scripts.backup:prod: wrangler d1 export mila-en-db-prod --remote --env production --output backup-prod.sql
